title: Efficient constitution of a library of rotenoid analogs active against Trypanosoma cruzi from a digitalized plant extract collection
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,15240-15251
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08652J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Arnaud Gaudry, Laurence Marcourt, Marcel Kaiser, Julien Flückiger, Bruno David, Antonio Grondin, Jean-Robert Ioset, Pascal Mäser, Emerson Ferreira Queiroz, Pierre-Marie Allard, Jean-Luc Wolfender
Branching out into knowledge! We build a KG to enrich and align metabolomics datasets, revealing bioactive compounds from plant extracts. We uncover anti-T. cruzi activity of rotenoids from 4 plant species, and isolate and characterize 41 analogs.
